turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Good morning, customer service. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Hi. I'm calling about my internet again. It keeps stopping every evening.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. When did it start?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: About a week ago. It stops at around eight and comes back at about ten. A technician came last Tuesday and reset the router, but it's happened every night since then.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: I see. Is it causing you a lot of problems?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Yes, it's a real problem, because I have online classes in the evening. I've missed two classes this week.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: I understand. I can send a technician on Thursday between nine and twelve. Or, because you need it for your classes, we can send you a new router by courier tomorrow.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Is the new router easy to set up? I'd like to fix this as soon as possible.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Yes, it takes about ten minutes. You just follow the card in the box.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Then please send the new router tomorrow. And if it still doesn't work, can the technician come on Thursday?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Of course. I'll book Thursday too, and you can cancel it if everything's fine.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Great. So a new router tomorrow, and a technician on Thursday between nine and twelve, just in case.
